controls.procedure: Compare every original row field using the independent oracle; remove an actual original operation ID and corrupt its date in private extracted pages.
controls.expected: All seven field types match on 38 rows; missing actual ID and invalid date block all proposals.
controls.observed: All 266 original field comparisons match. Actual-ID removal and invalid date block; four real synthetic PDFs preserve complete descriptions in parser and preview, with ambiguous/unassigned text blocked by focused tests.

controls.procedure: Run extractor permission tests with empty user password copy:no, copy:yes, missing encryption metadata and required-password stderr. Reproduce forged multiline Title, Author and Subject fields with both fake Encrypted:no and fake copy:yes before the authoritative copy:no field; assert no pdftotext invocation.
controls.expected: copy:no is rejected before pdftotext; permitted empty-password original is accepted.
controls.observed: Real copy:no and password PDFs reject PROTECTED before pdftotext; Title/Author/Subject permission forgeries reject INVALID before pdftotext. Permitted copy:yes remains ready.

controls.procedure: Run all five near-header/footer/lower-boundary controls and the three old-behavior mutations.
controls.expected: Complete reconciled rows are retained; overlapping/incomplete financial anchors block, contact numbers are ignored.
controls.observed: Five current-material boundary tests pass. Reintroduced lower cutoff, footer clipping and header-gap behavior each fail functional assertions after compiling isolated exact-source variants.

controls.procedure: Replay the exact official saturation command from A-006. In ephemeral copies remove the semantic-effect family and separately set applicable=false, keeping inherited controls unchanged.
controls.expected: Complete coverage returns exit 0; omission and deactivation return exit 2 for all three original inherited controls.
controls.observed: Measured official auditor gate on an explicitly isolated hypothetical complete packet returned 0; removing semantic-effect returned 2 and deactivating it returned 2. Both negatives named all three original inherited controls REGRESSION-A-001/A-004/A-005. The active self-control was pending until these executions completed.

controls.procedure: Replay the audit's real synthetic PDF and layout controls at the frozen material: final row, header-adjacent first row, non-final page and ambiguous row association.
controls.expected: Every accepted row preserves the entire description; unresolvable word association blocks the batch without partial proposals.
controls.observed: All 266 original field comparisons match. Actual-ID removal and invalid date block; four real synthetic PDFs preserve complete descriptions in parser and preview, with ambiguous/unassigned text blocked by focused tests.

controls.procedure: Run the existing object-31/catalog-1 regression together with corrupt-catalog controls. Extend the same fixture to single-CR, LF/CRLF headers, permitted horizontal PDF whitespace and inline comment/literal lookalikes.
controls.expected: Valid CR/LF/CRLF object headers are accepted, while complete root identity and inline-lookalike rejection are preserved.
controls.observed: Exact-source Catalog suite passes whitespace variants, complete object-ID and inline-lookalike rejection; real LF and one-byte CR PDFs both return ready with one row.
